rows.functionality: Allows the item to be stored in a Chiseled Bookshelf.

functionality: Allows the item to be used to craft a Decorated Pot.
Learn how to create custom pottery sherds [here](/items/custom-pottery-sherds).

rows.functionality: Allows the item to be used to scrape copper and strip logs.
Allows the item to be picked up by foxes.
Allows the item to be used to create dirt paths, extinguish campfires and turn layers of snow into snowballs.

functionality: Allows the item to be picked up by entities including the Bogged, Drowned, Parched, Skeleton and Stray.
Enables spear animations on entities including the Husk, Piglin, Player, Zombie, Zombie Villager and Zombified Piglin when held in the main hand.

rows.functionality: Allows the item to be used like logs when crafting blocks such as campfires and the Smoker.
Allows the item to be smelted in a furnace to create Charcoal.
Allows the item to be used like metal nuggets when crafting items such as the Name Tag.
Allows the item to be used as planks in crafting recipes.
Allows the item to be used like soul sand/soil when crafting blocks such as the Soul Campfire and Soul Torch.
Allows the item to be used like cobblestone when crafting blocks such as the Furnace and Brewing Stand.
Allows the item to be used like cobblestone to craft stone tools.
Allows the item to be trimmed in a Smithing Table.
Prevents the item from emitting vibrations when dropped onto the ground.
Allows the item to be used as wool in crafting recipes.
